definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese figurine of a cat with one paw raised in a beckoning gesture. Believed to bring good luck, prosperity, and customers to businesses. Commonly displayed in shops, restaurants, and homes.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{店|みせ}→お店：21164_omise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{入|い}り{口|ぐち}→入り口：02507_iriguchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{招|まね}き{猫|ねこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{置|お}いて→置く：01092_oku⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a lucky cat figurine at the entrance of the shop.

examples.japanese: {招|まね}き{猫|ねこ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{商売繁盛|しょうばいはんじょう}→商売繁盛：29953_shoubaihanjou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{縁起物|えんぎもの}→縁起物：15731_engimono⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The beckoning cat is a good luck charm for business prosperity.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{土産|みやげ}→お土産：01353_omiyage⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{招|まね}き{猫|ねこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。

- ⟦{白|しろ}→白：13854_shiro⟧ (white) - general good luck
- ⟦{黒|くろ}→黒：02205_kuro⟧ (black) - protection from evil
- ⟦{金|きん}→金：02666_kin⟧ (gold) - wealth and prosperity

- Originated during the Edo period
- ⟦{豪徳寺|ごうとくじ}→豪徳寺：noentry⟧ (Gotokuji Temple) in Tokyo is famous for {招|まね}き{猫|ねこ}
- ⟦{常滑焼|とこなめやき}→常滑焼：noentry⟧ (Tokoname ware) is a famous production area

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{縁起物|えんぎもの}→縁起物：15731_engimono⟧ (good luck charm)
- ⟦{商売繁盛|しょうばいはんじょう}→商売繁盛：29953_shoubaihanjou⟧ (business prosperity)
- ⟦{千客万来|せんきゃくばんらい}→千客万来：29954_senkyakubanrai⟧ (flood of customers)

MODERN USE:
- Ubiquitous in Japanese businesses, especially restaurants and shops
- Popular as souvenirs and gifts
- Has become internationally recognized
